summary: Frontend-only pass on the offline Ledger app (public preview URL, 390x844 viewport). PRIMARY BUG VERIFIED FIXED: dashboard category-filter-dropdown now opens an opaque Modal menu fully ABOVE the 'No spends yet' card (bg rgb(255,255,255), opacity 1, elementFromPoint returns category-option-all as topmost), all 8 options (All categories + 7 defaults) visible and tappable, selecting Food updates trigger label, backdrop tap dismisses. Add payment flow PASS (sheet dropdown has no 'All categories', save updates total/breakdown/recent spends). Transfer-on-delete PASS (transfer box appears, dropdown excludes 'All categories' and deleted category, 'Move & delete' reassigns spends, verified on dashboard). Regressions PASS: quick-action rows tappable, edit payment, PDF preview total renders, strict date validation rejects 31/02/2026 (error shown, nothing persisted). UNABLE TO VERIFY on web: delete-payment + Undo snackbar — Alert.alert is a no-op in RN-web (no dialog/DOM renders), so the delete confirm never appears on the preview; expected to work on Android/Expo Go.

integration_issues.issue: Alert.alert does not render on the web preview (react-native-web platform limitation), so delete confirmation and the subsequent Undo flow cannot be exercised in preview. Not a code bug — works on native — but means this flow has zero web-preview coverage.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' on web preview from shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius in styles. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:203 (fab, dropdownMenu styles).

Six duplicated 'breakdownLine' keys in the style object suppressed via '/* eslint-disable no-dupe-keys */' and '@ts-ignore'. Harmless at runtime (last wins) but a maintenance smell; collapse to one key. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:203.

action_items: Optional: replace shadow* style props with boxShadow to silence the RN-web deprecation warning.
Optional: remove duplicated breakdownLine style keys and the eslint-disable/@ts-ignore workarounds.
Optional hardening: disable the Save button (disabled={!valid || saving}) in PaymentForm in addition to showing the inline error; current tap-on-invalid shows error correctly, so not required.
Verify delete-payment Alert + Undo snackbar on an Android/Expo Go build since web preview cannot render Alert.alert.
critical_code_review_comments: CategoryDropdown Modal fix is correctly implemented: measureInWindow anchor, transparent full-screen Modal, opens upward near screen bottom, maxHeight 280 scrollable, backdrop dismiss — all verified working.
includeAll={false} correctly applied to both the payment form and transfer dropdowns; verified neither shows 'All categories' and transfer dropdown also excludes the category being deleted.
dateValue strict validation (parsed date must match entered Y/M/D) confirmed working — 31/02/2026 rejected.

PaymentForm save button is only disabled while saving, not when invalid; tapping with invalid data shows 'Enter an amount, category, and valid date.' and persists nothing — meets the stated requirement.
seed_data_creation: Temporary localStorage seed payments (TEST metro card, TEST lunch, TEST del) created for testing and fully cleared afterwards; preview left in clean empty state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested flows pass on the web preview. The dropdown-under-card bug is fixed and independently verified. Only gap: delete+undo cannot be tested on web because Alert.alert is a no-op in react-native-web; if regression coverage is needed, test on a native build or replace Alert with an in-app confirm modal.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: inline absolute-positioned dropdown menu rendered inside a ScrollView/card stacking context, so the empty-state card painted above it and intercepted touches. Fix verified: menu now renders in a transparent full-screen RN Modal (topmost native layer) anchored via measureInWindow, with opaque surfaceSecondary background — confirmed topmost via elementFromPoint returning category-option-all.
